provenance.source_ref: User project direction in the CAD-Grounded ChatGPT project conversation: do not treat the V43 Prism geometry as mandatory architecture; derive and compare bottle-handling mechanisms from the required labeling functions.

admitted_project_direction: Existing V43 Prism fit-check geometry remains preserved as candidate/research evidence.
The project is not committed to the V43 slider/link/arm mechanism as the required bottle-handling architecture.
Mechanism selection must start from bottle-labeling functions and verified constraints, then compare multiple deterministic candidate families.
A new candidate may replace V43 if it better satisfies the same mechanical obligations.
explicitly_not_claimed: This project-direction record is not evidence that any particular mechanism is mechanically correct.
It does not grant mechanical acceptance or CAD write authority.
It does not invalidate prior V43 measurements; those remain bounded evidence about Candidate A.
